title: MyXTape: music sync platform
summary: Automated Spotify and Apple Music content ingestion that respects API limits.
impact: Smoother artist onboarding and reliable continuous sync.
problem: The client needed reliable streaming integration with Spotify and Apple Music while staying within API limits.
solution: Built a music-sync integration with automated content ingestion pipelines, backend modules and metadata indexing workflows for heavy data refreshes.
result: Enabled smooth artist onboarding and improved sync reliability across third-party music services.
